**At Murj, we do what we love and love what we do!** Murj was founded in 2014 to solve a problem witnessed first-hand. Founder and CEO, Todd, worked with cardiology practices as an implantable cardiac device sales representative for Medtronic. He watched clinicians struggle to manage these sophisticated devices using outdated and inadequate tools. Having previously worked in product management at Apple, Todd knew that brilliant design can profoundly impact the user experience -- so why not design a better way to care for patients with implantable devices? In Murj, Todd created an enterprise SaaS cardiac device management software solutions company that reimagines and transforms patient care through thoughtful design and a passion for quality and a commitment to customer satisfaction. Today, Murj continues this transformative innovation with intuitive, elegant, and imaginative technology solutions that improve the lives of cardiac care professionals and their patients. **What Murj offers.** Murj is for people seeking a fast-paced, ever-changing environment surrounded by a supportive team that works hard and strives for innovation and professionalism, with a steady diet of humility and camaraderie. Every employee is treated like family, with love, respect, and responsibility. The individual and collective success of every employee is at the forefront of what we do and believe. And in joining Murj, you are joining a community that believes in evolution and promotion from within; there is a high degree of opportunity for progression, creativity, and ownership. From your first day at Murj, you are eligible for full medical, dental, and vision insurance along with an open vacation policy, more than 10 annual company holidays, and competitive compensation and equity participation, and a 401(k) after 3 months of service. **How We Work at Murj** Murj is the right place for people who excel in fast-paced, dynamic environments. Murj embodies a high-performance culture where every team member is expected to exceed expectations and take ownership beyond their role to drive our collective success. Employees should be comfortable working independently and taking initiative to identify and address needs. This proactive approach is essential to thriving at Murj. We believe in working hard together, with a shared sense of purpose and drive. We’re not afraid to ask tough questions, and we support each other in reaching for bold new ideas. **Let us leave you with this.** If this role sounds intriguing - we encourage you to apply. And we encourage applicants to embrace new challenges, as the right fit at Murj is often more about the person and the challenges they seek, not just what they have accomplished in the past. **About The Role.** Murj is seeking a resourceful and highly organized Junior Graphic Designer to help strengthen how our brand is created, maintained, and used across the organization. This role is about more than producing one-off designs. You will help us build a thoughtful, reusable system of brand assets, templates, and resources that enables teams to work efficiently while presenting Murj consistently. Working closely with the Head of Graphic Design and Director of Marketing, you will support a wide range of creative needs, including presentations, marketing collateral, social graphics, video, and print materials. You will primarily work within Murj’s existing visual identity while contributing ideas that help the brand and its supporting resources evolve. This role is well suited to someone who combines strong visual fundamentals with a systems-oriented mindset—someone who enjoys making great work, organizing it well, and finding solutions when the path is not already defined. **What You’ll Do.** - **Build and Manage Our Brand Asset Library:** Organize, maintain, and improve Murj’s shared library of graphics, templates, presentations, video elements, and other reusable creative resources. Establish practical systems for naming, versioning, finding, and using assets. - **Steward Brand Guidelines and Templates:** Help maintain and expand the Murj brand guide, translating brand standards into useful templates and tools for teams across the organization. Support colleagues in using those resources effectively and consistently. - **Create High-Quality Marketing Materials:** Design and refine presentations, campaign graphics, sales and marketing collateral, graphic elements, and other materials based on the needs of the design and marketing teams. - **Support Social and Digital Content:** Create engaging, on-brand graphics for social media and digital campaigns, with an emphasis on developing reusable systems rather than rebuilding common assets each time. - **Edit and Create Video Content:** Help clean up, edit, assemble, and prepare video content for marketing, social, sales, and internal use. Create titles, graphic elements, and simple motion treatments as appropriate. - **Prepare and Refine Print Materials:** Produce polished, print-ready materials and ensure files meet visual, technical, and production requirements. - **Explore Smarter Creative Workflows:** Help Murj evaluate and responsibly incorporate AI-enabled creative tools into its brand and asset workflows. Look for practical ways to improve efficiency while maintaining quality, accuracy, and brand consistency. - **Support Website and Special Projects:** Contribute visual assets and design support for Murj’s upcoming website work and other cross-functional initiatives. This role is not primarily focused on product UI, but familiarity with web design or Figma is valuable. **What Makes You a Great Fit.** - **A Systems Mindset:** You enjoy organization, clear naming conventions, and turning one-off designs into scalable, reusable templates. - **Resourcefulness:** Faced with an unfamiliar tool or assignment, you take the initiative to research, experiment, and figure it out. - **Balanced Stewardship:** You collaborate smoothly with non-design stakeholders, incorporating their input while protecting brand consistency. - **Versatility:** You easily switch contexts—moving between presentation decks, video edits, social graphics, and asset management without missing a detail. - **Modern Workflow Curiosity:** You are excited to test new tools, automation, and AI features to work smarter and cut down on repetitive tasks. **What You Bring.** - Graphic design experience demonstrated through a strong portfolio, internships, freelance work, or comparable projects. - A portfolio demonstrating strong typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and attention to detail across digital and print work. - Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign. - Experience creating and refining presentations in PowerPoint or Google Slides. - Experience with shared asset libraries or digital asset-management systems. - Working knowledge of print-production requirements and file preparation. - Strong organizational skills and an interest in building clear, reusable systems for assets and templates. - The ability to receive feedback, manage multiple assignments, and follow work through to completion. - A resourceful, curious approach to unfamiliar tools or assignments—you are comfortable researching, experimenting, and figuring out how to move the work forward. - Strong collaboration and communication skills. **Nice To Haves.** - 2-3 years of relevant graphic design experience. - Motion graphics or animation experience, particularly in After Effects. - Experience editing video using Premiere Pro or a comparable tool. - Familiarity with Figma, website design, or digital design systems. - Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and responsible creative-use practices. - Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS. - Experience in healthcare, SaaS, or another technical industry. **What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days).** During your first 90 days, success means learning Murj’s brand, becoming a reliable creative partner, and beginning to improve how our design resources are organized and used. You will have: - Built a working understanding of Murj’s brand, products, audiences, and visual standards. - Audited existing brand assets, templates, and shared resources and identified opportunities to improve their organization and usability. - Established an initial structure for maintaining, naming, updating, and distributing commonly used assets. - Updated or improved priority templates and internal brand resources. - Begun delivering dependable creative support across presentations, graphics, social content, video, and print projects. - Started positively influencing how teams find, use, and apply Murj’s brand assets. - Identified practical opportunities to improve creative workflows, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools. **Location and schedule.** This is a remote-friendly position; however, the role requires core working hours of **8:00 AM – 5:00 PM i**n the employee's timezone to support our clinical customers and internal teams. **Travel expectations:** 1-10%: Minimal to no travel; maybe a few meetings or events

## FPGA ENGINEER (NEW GRAD SUMMER 2027) Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits. As an FPGA Engineer at Freeform, you will play a key role in developing and deploying the software systems that power our autonomous metal 3D printing factories. You’ll work with a talented engineering team from some of the world’s most innovative companies across a range of projects including controls, high-speed data acquisition, high-performance computing (GPU’s and FPGA’s), and geometry processing pipelines that enable precise and fully automated manufacturing at scale. Welcome to the DNC Technology Internship Application! The DNC Technology department is accepting applications for our Spring 2027 Internship Program! This is a separate application from the DNC General Internship Application because it requires specific experience. Interning with DNC Tech is a unique opportunity for future leaders to gain real life, hands-on experience in Democratic political technology, learn and experience industry data & analytics processes, strengthen their understanding of the political process, and prepare them for future political opportunities. The program will run from January 11, 2027 - March 19, 2027 and will be conducted in an in-person, hybrid, or remote format. Interns who are based in the Washington D.C. area will have an opportunity to perform in-person work for the DNC at the Democratic National Committee Headquarters and DNC events. You must be located in the United States to apply for this internship. The DNC Internship Program provides a stipend of $3,700. Housing is not provided. During the upcoming term, interns are expected to work 20 hours per week. The deadline for applications is November 27, 2026. Position Summary: As an intern with DNC Tech, you will work on a project or projects designed to support the work of the overall Tech team and your own skills and experience. You will build your skills as a technology professional, in data analytics, engineering, or data science; software engineering; product; or supporting users of data and technology products, or cybersecurity. You will participate in team meetings and work closely with mentor(s). In addition to working on project/s, you may work on a variety of additional tasks relevant to the team you’re interning with. As an intern with DNC Tech, you’ll learn a lot about the interesting ways in which technology intersects politics. As part of the internship program, you will also be expected to assist the DNC Operations team by attending weekly phone shifts and any mandatory onboarding/offboarding sessions. In addition, through the internship program, you will have opportunities to participate in grassroots organizing, assist at DNC functions, receive personal development training, and network with DNC leadership and staff. NOTE: The Data team at the DNC are fully remote teams. Tech interns may work from any contiguous US time zone. If working from AK or HI, you must be able to do work during either Pacific, Mountain, Central, or Eastern time working hours. You will arrange a schedule with a supervisor. Technology interns still have the opportunity to choose among in-person, hybrid, or remote work like every DNC intern, but be aware that your supervisor and mentors will likely be remote. An internship at DNC Tech may be a great fit for you if: You’re willing to learn new things, and you feel comfortable learning and problem-solving on your own, with guidance from a mentor. You enjoy problem-solving and have strong communication skills. You are excited to learn about the ways that tech can support Democratic politics, and to work on things that help others. You have previous experience in politics, e.g. using Votebuilder, or volunteering for a Democratic campaign. (This is NOT required.) For the data internship, we recommend: You have completed at least a semester, ideally two semesters, of computer programming-related courses, OR have equivalent experience. We expect interns on the Data team to have done some computer programming or data manipulation / analysis previously Our team uses a lot of SQL, Python, and R but it is okay if you’ve never used one of those before, as long as you have some familiarity with programming or spreadsheet software including Excel or Google Sheets. If you’ve used one of those languages or software, or something else similar to one of those, we encourage you to apply! For the cybersecurity internship, we recommend: You have at least an entry-level skill-set in using MacBooks and Google Suite applications Our team constantly has to adapt to industry changes that happen almost daily – therefore, having a passion for technology and learning new things is required Basic Scripting: Ability to write entry-level scripts in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate simple tasks or parse data. Security Core Concepts: Understanding of fundamental principles such as the CIA triad, authentication mechanisms, common threats (phishing, malware), and industry recognized security frameworks (CIS, NIST, etc.). AI Security & Tool Awareness: Familiarity with basic AI security concepts such as prompt injection and data privacy risks. Include in your application for a DNC Tech internship: In your cover letter, tell us why do you want to intern here, specifically? Tell us about a time you solved a problem or learned something new. (Briefly - 1 paragraph or less is fine!) Share in your resume and/or cover letter what software / technology / programming skills, and experiences you have. What are the titles of a couple relevant classes you’ve taken? What technology related project /s (ex. an assignment from a class) have you worked on? This information helps us determine whether we have a project that will match your experience and interest. About the team: The DNC Technology department (aka DNC Tech) is a small, collaborative, multi-disciplinary tech team – we provide the tech foundation for Democratic politics. You can learn more about the team here . We build tools and applications that help elect Democrats year over year. Our work is an incredibly important background part of running successful Democratic campaigns around the country, including: Ensuring permissions and onboarding/offboarding work properly and that our data tools are secure, Ensuring we have accurate, accessible data, Building tools so that people working hard on campaigns and in other political roles can save time and energy, Making it possible for those with voter protection expertise to share accurate information about how to vote, Supporting people throughout the Democratic ecosystem with secure hardware, software, device management, and other technology problems, … and much more. Eligibility Requirements: Applicants must be 18 years of age on or before the first day of the internship and meet at least one of the following criteria: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program at a college, community college, or university (two-to-four year institution). It is highly recommended that applicants complete at least one full term prior to submitting an application. Graduated from an undergraduate or graduate program at a college, community college, or university (two-to-four year institution) no more than two years before the first day of the internship. A veteran of the United States Armed Forces who possesses a high school diploma or its equivalent and has served on active duty, for any length of time, in the two years preceding the first day of the internship. Applicants must meet all of the following criteria: Commitment of 20 hours per week during the program Physically present in the United States to participate in this internship program Required Application Materials: Resume Cover letter References SECTION: CLOSING Due to the volume of applications, we cannot review materials submitted outside the application form. Essential Duties and Responsibilities of a successful candidate include but are not limited to: Design horizontal alignments and vertical profiles for roadway widening and improvement projects Develop 3D models and plans using AutoDesk Civil 3D and/or Bentley OpenRoads Designer Create visualizations for client and public presentations using 3D software Prepare detailed plan sheets and complete project submission packages Perform roadway and drainage calculations using engineering software and reference materials Assist in preparing engineering and construction cost estimates Research and utilize open-source GIS data for project planning Conduct field observations and data collection to support design discussions Stay current with emerging technologies to enhance team capabilities Participate in client and contractor meetings to support project delivery Skill/Requirements of a successful candidate include but are not limited to: A bachelor’s or master's degree in civil engineering or a closely related degree with coursework in transportation/traffic preferred EIT preferred Experience with Bentley OpenRoads Designer and/or AutoDesk Civil 3D (preferred) Familiarity with VDOT standards and procedures (preferred) The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. We are looking for high energy, creative, flexible, patient, self-starters who are willing to work at a dynamic pace. Candidates must share a commitment to our company’s Vision, Mission and Shared Values. Timmons Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. Timmons Group is a full-service engineering and technology firm recognized nationally as a “Best Firm to Work For” by CE News. As one of Engineering News Record’s (ENR) Top 500 Design Firms for over 30 years, we are dedicated to being an employer of choice and providing our people with the best resources, technology, and culture to help them thrive in an engaging career development setting. For more information, visit . #LI-KH1

Clēnera is a tier-one developer and independent power producer located in Boise, Idaho, and is the U.S. subsidiary of [Enlight Renewable Energy](https://enlightenergy.co.il/) (Nasdaq: [ENLT](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/enlt)). We develop, finance, construct, own, and operate utility-scale solar and energy storage facilities throughout the United States. In its 2025 analysis of solar independent power producers, S&P Global ranked Clēnera as a top ten U.S. owner of planned installations in the next five years. Clēnera has over 1.9 GW of solar and 5.1 GWh of storage in operations or construction, and a development pipeline totaling 17.8 GW of solar and 51.1 GWh of storage across 23 states. Our company culture is at the core of everything we do, so you’ll regularly find Caring, Committed, and Courageous individuals who value respectful, cross-functional collaboration with partners internally and externally. With our tremendous portfolio growth, we are increasing our headcount to meet the demands of the business. Are you ready to change the world with us? **ABOUT THE ROLE** The internship program at Clēnera is designed to give current undergraduates an opportunity to immerse themselves into the complex world of renewable energy. We have created thoughtful experiences across the company to provide meaningful experiences for the interns and value for the organization. Students who will be successful in this program will bring a passion for the renewable energy industry, a strong work ethic centered around self-motivation, and a desire to learn and grow by working alongside some of the best and brightest in the industry. The Engineering Intern will gain exposure to both the operational and design phases of utility-scale solar projects, including reviewing technical specifications of the major pieces of equipment used in our projects. You will support a wide range of engineering activities from early-stage project engineering, supplier quality, and performance engineering efforts. This role will analyze operating site data, assist in the design review and value engineering process for photovoltaic (PV) projects, and contribute to early-stage layout generation and energy modeling using PVsyst software. *\*Paid 12-week internship opportunity starting in May/June 2027.* **WHAT YOU'LL DO** - Analyze operational data from existing solar and storage projects, identifying performance trends, potential inefficiencies, and areas for optimization to improve site energy output and system reliability. - Participate in the design review process of photovoltaic (PV) projects, offering support in evaluating system components, layouts, and cost-saving opportunities. - Support the development of initial PV layouts for new solar and storage projects, taking into account site-specific factors like topography, shading, and project constraints. - Model and simulate the energy production of PV projects using PVsyst, including estimating annual energy yield, performance ratios, and system losses under various conditions. - Review and analyze studies focused on the effects of utility-scale solar on surrounding land and ecosystems, providing insights that may influence project designs and promote sustainable development practices. - Review and validate supplier-provided technical documentation to ensure alignment with project design specifications, industry standards, and established QA/QC requirements for modules, battery containers, and other major equipment. - Monitor and assess results from third‑party quality services (3PQA) providers (e.g., FAT, IPM, PSI inspections and supplier audits) tracking findings, escalating concerns, and verifying timely resolution. - Partner with the Engineering and Supply Chain teams during supplier and equipment selection to evaluate quality, reliability, and technical fit for project needs. - Collaborate with individual department, as well as cross-functionally with other departments within the organization. - Maintain organizational excellence in terms of project timelines and deliverables. - Demonstrates the Clēnera Core Values of Caring, Committed, and Courageous. - Other duties as assigned. **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS** - Education: Undergraduate or graduate student, preferably entering their final year, pursing a degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, or related field. - Technology: Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and an ability to learn company-specific software programs, tools, processes, and machines. - Skills/Attributes: - Basic aptitude for electrical engineering principles and energy analysis. - Familiar with basic programming in Python and VBA, like writing simple scripts to automate tasks and enhance productivity. - Ability to analyze performance data of solar farms to identify trends and optimize efficiency. - Self-motivated to work through complex problems and competing priorities, including a high level of detail and organization. - Effective verbal and written communication skills. *\*Recruiting agencies, we are not currently accepting unsolicited referrals for this or any open role. We will not pay any fee associated with unsolicited referrals.* *At Clēnera, LLC, we’re an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by state or federal law.*

**Who We Are** **MEMX** is a technology-driven exchange operator founded by members to benefit all investors. We operate MEMX Equities, MEMX Options, and MX2 Options, and provide market technology to clients. Our mission is to create healthy competition and advocate for market structure reform that results in more efficient and sensible trading experiences for all investors. **Description** **MEMX**is seeking a **Network Engineering Intern** to learn how the networks behind our U.S. equities and options exchanges are built and supported. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers on hands-on projects and gain exposure to the reliable, low-latency infrastructure that supports trading. This internship position will be offered as hybrid with 1-day in person at our Data Center in North Bergen, NJ, and 2-days in person at our co-working office in Midtown-NYC. **Work Schedule** The intern will be expected to work the following schedule: - Monday: 1:00pm – 10:00pm ET, *in person at our North Bergen Data Center* - Tuesday: 10:00am – 6:00pm ET, *remote* - Wednesday: 9:00am – 5:00pm ET, *in person at our co-working office in Midtown-NYC* - Thursday: 9:00am – 5:00pm ET, *in person at our co-working office in Midtown-NYC* - Friday: 9:00am – 5:00pm ET, *remote* Hours are subject to change based on operational needs. **\*MEMX has currently approved ONLY the following states for remote work:** *California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, & Utah.* **What You’ll Be Doing** - Help the team monitor network performance and investigate alerts and connectivity issues - Assist with network device configuration, testing, and documentation under the guidance of experienced engineers - Assist with data center activities such as racking, network and hardware, running optical fibers, etc. - Contribute to projects involving network tools, automation, and infrastructure improvements - Collaborate with teams across MEMX to understand how network engineering supports the exchange **Requirements** - Current undergraduate student entering their junior or senior year, pursuing Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field - Foundational understanding of networking concepts such as IP addressing, routing, and switching through coursework, projects, or personal interests - Interest in troubleshooting and learning how large-scale networks operate - Strong attention to detail and willingness to ask questions and learn from the team - Exposure to Python, Linux, or Wireshark is a plus, but not required - Ability to work in person at our Midtown Manhattan office during the summer - Permanent residence in one of MEMX’s approved states for remote work during the internship **What You’ll Gain** - Hands-on experience with the network infrastructure that supports a securities exchange - Exposure to various Options and Equities exchange platforms and how network connectivity supplements these platforms - Exposure to network monitoring, troubleshooting, and day-to-day operations - Learn how customer connections are set up and supported - Mentorship and guidance from experienced network engineers - Opportunities to collaborate with technology teams across MEMX and connect with fellow interns **Why MEMX** At MEMX, you’ll contribute to meaningful work alongside experienced professionals while developing your skills and learning how our exchanges operate. As part of our summer internship program, you’ll also have access to: - **Learning opportunities:** Attend Lunch & Learn sessions, professional development workshops, and relevant courses - **Mentorship and support:** Learn from a mentor and a designated buddy who can help guide you throughout the summer - **An intern cohort:** Connect with interns working across other MEMX teams - **Social events:** Get to know colleagues, with opportunities to connect with members of MEMX’s C-suite - **Regular feedback:** Check in with your manager and HR to discuss your progress, ask questions, and get support - **Future opportunities:** All interns are considered for potential internship extensions or a full-time opportunity after graduation, based on performance and business needs **Pay Rate:** $30/hourly for undergraduate students **Equal Opportunity Statement** MEMX is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. **Diversity Inclusion Statement** At MEMX, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving innovation and success. We welcome and celebrate individuals from all backgrounds and perspectives, and we strive to create an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

description: ### **About Us:** Perpay is a certified B Corp and Philadelphia’s most impactful growth-stage startup. We are driven by a mission to significantly improve the financial stability of everyday Americans. For the past decade, we have established strong product-market fit and a profitable, efficient operating model across a suite of products, positioning Perpay as the premier financial partner for consumers with subprime credit. With over 500,000 customers who have utilized more than $1 billion in spending power, we are at a pivotal moment. We are scaling our operations, building new offerings, and deepening our impact. We are looking for teammates eager to join us on this journey. Our venture partners include First Round Capital and L Catterton. Products we’ve built to make an impact: - Perpay Marketplace: Combines interest-free payments and modern e-commerce to reduce cost of ownership and promote healthy repayment behavior. - Perpay+: Leverages Marketplace repayment history to help members monitor and build credit with all 3 credit bureaus. - Perpay Credit Card: Expands access to the flexibility and benefits of a World Mastercard by removing common barriers like high security deposits and low approval odds. Our team thrives on in-person collaboration, operating from our unique center-city Philadelphia office. This comfortable "home away from home" space offers river views and fosters rapid product development, strong relationships, and career growth. The energy from achieving big wins is palpable here. While we primarily work in the office, we offer sensible flexibility for personal needs, such as sick children or urgent errands, and coordinate official remote weeks around major holidays. If you are passionate about a meaningful mission, collaboration, equity, and generous perks, Perpay is the best place to be in Philadelphia right now. ## *This is a 🚀 Super Day Hiring Event 🚀 specific job posting.* ### **What is Super Day?** #### It's an accelerated hiring event that will give recent graduates the unique opportunity to land this role in *just one day*! We will host it on November 12th at Perpay HQ in Philadelphia. Selected candidates will tour the office, meet the team, and experience a fast-tracked interview process. Attendance is invite-only, and applicants must complete all pre-work steps to be considered. Launch your career by applying below! \**Application Deadline: November 2nd.* --- ### **About the Role:** We are looking for motivated graduates (or equivalent experience) to join our Software Engineering team! You’ll contribute to our codebase, test & release features into production, and collaborate with other teams like product, design, data science, analytics, and operations. The ideal candidate has software development internship experience and is enthusiastic about learning and growing! We're particularly interested in working with candidates excited about joining a mission-driven startup. On our team, you’ll sharpen your skills, learn new tools alongside other new graduates, and learn from experienced engineers. Plus, our team organizes events and social gatherings outside of work hours. We believe having a fun and engaging work environment is essential to fostering a positive company culture and creating a strong foundation for career growth. Much of our team is full-stack, so we look for team members excited to learn new technologies and work across all stacks, even if it’s not something you’ve done before! Our tech stack: JavaScript, React, React Native, Redux, Python, Django, Kubernetes, AWS, Docker, Terraform, and more. Our greatest strength is our people, and we’d love for you to be one of them! ### **Responsibilities:** - Develop, test, and release features for our customer-facing and internal platforms alongside the engineering team - Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code - Collaborate cross-functionally to develop efficient and user-friendly solutions to support the complex needs of our business - Actively participate in design reviews, code reviews, and discussions to improve our software architecture and implement efficient processes within our engineering team ### **What You’ll Bring:** - Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or higher, or a recent graduate studying Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience) - 1 to 2 previous Software Engineering internships with a focus on full-stack software development - Experience with at least one backend application framework such as Django or Flask - Experience with frontend technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.js - Knowledge of RESTful API design and integration - Experience with Python or another dynamically typed language - A strong focus on writing and deploying clear, readable, testable code - Ability to pick up new technologies quickly, with software engineering fundamentals being valued more than familiarity with specific tools or languages - Eagerness to learn, grow, and seek feedback from team members - Strong communication skills Even if you don't check all the boxes, please apply if interested. You might be exactly what we're looking for! ### **What We’ll Bring to Full-time Team Members:** - Meaningful compensation and equity - Premium medical benefits (fully paid base plan, and very reasonable premium for the buy-up option) - 5% employer 401k match - Unlimited PTO policy - ​​Remote weeks around major holidays + extra holiday on weekends like MDW and LDW - High quality catered lunch by local chefs, 4 days / week - Gym subsidy - Paid cell phone + plan - Student loan repayment match program - Family savings match program - Relocation assistance - Generous team member discounts This is not a remote opportunity; it is 100% onsite (#LI-Onsite) (#LI-TH1) (#LI-AK1) *Perpay is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity in all its forms and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex (including pregnancy), marital status, political affiliation, age, veteran status, disability status or other non-merit factor. Please contact us at to request accommodation.*

## **About us** At Roadrunner, we’re replacing the broken CPQ software that Sales teams have complained about, worked around, and given up on for years. Not improving it - replacing it. We’re building a new agentic stack called PQA - Prompt, Quote, Approve, designed for the enterprise, on a data model built for how pricing actually works today. We’re Kleiner Perkins’ first incubation since Glean, led by second-time founders with successful exits, and a team of engineers from Snowflake, Databricks, Citadel, Meta, Robinhood, Brex, and so on. We’re in-person in San Francisco, and we’re just getting started. ## **What you'll do** - **Embed with our customers.** You'll sit with the RevOps and Sales leaders who live inside Roadrunner every day, turn their hardest pricing and approval problems into shipped features, and stay on the hook until they're actually solved - not just handed off to support. - **Own delivery end-to-end, in production.** From technical discovery through go-live, you're the engineer who scopes it, builds it, and keeps it running. - **Turn one-off solutions into product.** Every customer-specific integration or workflow you build feeds back into Roadrunner's core platform. The pattern you build for customer #1 is the feature customer #10 gets out of the box. - **Ship AI agents in the field.** Deploy and tune proactive agents - quoting recommendations, deal modeling, multi-step approval workflows - against real customer data and real deal pressure, then iterate on what actually breaks. - **Be the fastest feedback loop in the company.** You're often the first to see where the product breaks under real enterprise complexity. You carry that back to the core team the same day, not next sprint. ## **What you'll bring** - **Strong engineering fundamentals** - from coursework, internships, or projects. You don't need a track record of shipping to production yet; you need to be able to build fast without cutting the corners that matter. - **Real curiosity.** You want to know why something broke, not just that it broke - and you'll dig through an unfamiliar codebase or a customer's system until you find the actual answer. - **Ambition.** You want real ownership fast, not a backlog of tickets, and you're ready to earn it. - **Comfort with ambiguity** - from a hackathon, a research project, or an internship where nobody handed you a spec. - **Clear, direct communication** - with engineers and with the non-technical people you'll be sitting across from. - **Willingness to travel occasionally** to be onsite with customers when it matters. - **Based in SF or excited to relocate** - we're an in-person team. ## **Bonus points if…** - You've interned somewhere and shipped code that real users touched. - You've built something on your own - an app, a tool, a research project - because you wanted it to exist, not because a class required it. - You've spent time close to customers or end users, even outside of engineering (support, tutoring, ops), and know what it's like to translate someone's problem into something you build. - You've picked up a new language, framework, or domain fast because a project needed it. - You have a side project. Tell us what it is and why you built it. ## **What we offer** - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family. - Lunch and dinner, as well as snacks and coffee to keep you energized. - Take what you need vacation policy. ## **Equal opportunity** We value our differences, and we encourage all to apply — especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Roadrunner is an equal opportunity employer.

Roll up your sleeves and get to work in our Construction Materials Testing Lab. This is a hands-on, physically active role where you will be handling, mixing, breaking, and testing real construction materials like concrete, soil, asphalt, and masonry every day. If you enjoy working with your hands, solving practical problems, and seeing tangible results from your work, this is the job for you. Candidates will be responsible for performing laboratory tests related to Concrete, Soil, Asphalt, Masonry, and other construction materials in accordance with applicable testing standards/methods. What You'll Do Get hands-on with soils and construction materials — mixing, molding, curing, and physically testing samples using standardized lab methods. Operate and work directly with lab testing equipment (compression machines, sieves, molds, ovens, and more). Lift, carry, and move materials and samples as part of daily testing routines. Record and report test results accurately, following ASTM and other industry standards. Keep the lab running smoothly — cleaning, organizing, and maintaining equipment and workspaces. Calibrate and verify lab equipment to ensure testing accuracy. Pitch in on field/construction materials testing support when needed. Perform all other duties as assigned by your supervisor or manager. A genuine interest in working with construction materials in a physical, lab-based environment. Willingness to learn technical testing skills; full training provided. You'll be expected to earn your ACI Concrete Lab Testing Certification within 6 months. Solid basic math skills. Physical capability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs regularly. Strong communication skills, both written and oral, to log and report findings clearly. For more information, please visit Hourly Rate: $18-$22/hr Your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. SOCOTEC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Through an integrated, holistic approach, our professionals provide solutions for building envelope, energy efficiency, sustainability, code advisory and construction advisory projects. SOCOTEC’s combination of expertise, experience and methods are increasingly recognized as best-in-class fueling significant growth. SOCOTEC is proud to announce that it has been officially certified as a Great Place to Work by the renowned global authority on workplace culture, Great Place to Work®.

[Relay](https://relaypro.com/) is the Intelligent System of Action for the physical economy. While the digital revolution has often left the deskless workforce behind, we are closing that gap by transforming analog frontline operations into a data-rich, AI-powered ecosystem. We aren't just selling radios, we're building the digital foundation for the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't work at a desk. **Why Join Relay?** - **A Proven Winner:** Join a hyper-growth company trusted by over 10% of the Fortune 500, continuing to move upmarket with massive impact. - **High Value, High Impact:** With 47% of our revenue from $100K+ ARR customers and 135% Net Revenue Retention (NRR), you'll be joining a company rooted in value creation. - **Market-Leading Innovation:** The Relay platform captures 1 billion new data points weekly and features award-winning AI tools like TeamTranslate™, with 500% YoY growth. - **World-Class Leadership:** Our stellar leadership team is built to help us scale toward our next major milestones. - **The Relay Culture:** We're dedicated to helping you do the best work of your life (BWIML), investing in your growth, living out our CHASE values, and learning from talented teammates who make the work and the wins better every day. **Now, here's what we're building, and where you come in.** ## **About the Role** Value Engineering at Relay is the bridge between frontline operational reality and enterprise investment decisions. Our Value Engineers parachute into a prospect's world, learn how they operate, and build the financial case that proves Relay's ROI at the C-suite level. This is analytical, customer-facing, high-stakes work. This internship puts you in the middle of it. The Value Engineering Internship is a two-phase opportunity: a Spring semester engagement (January start, part-time) that potentially feeds into a full-time 40-hour/week Summer internship for top performers. Both phases are on-site at Relay's world-class Raleigh HQ, located near the Lenovo Center. Strong performance creates a pathway to a return offer for a Summer or Fall 2027 internship and full-time consideration upon graduation, based on business needs. You'll work directly with our Manager, Value Engineering, and the broader GTM org. This includes Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and senior leadership — on live enterprise deals. ## **About the Team** The Value Engineering team exists to close two critical gaps: leadership isn't always in touch with the factory floor, and new technology doesn't always translate into operational impact. We bridge both by quantifying Relay's value proposition, building investment-grade business cases, and acting as a forcing function for customer ROI. Our work shapes the enterprise sales motion, customer relationships, product roadmap, and company strategy. ## **Responsibilities** - Support the development of executive-level business cases that translate frontline operational data into P&L-level ROI. - Map prospect workflows and analyze operational metrics to identify Relay's highest-impact use cases. - Build financial models that quantify the value Relay delivers across manufacturing, logistics, hospitality, and healthcare. - Partner with AEs and CSMs on pilot strategies and account planning for key enterprise opportunities. - Conduct research on industry operations and competitive benchmarks to strengthen Relay's value narratives. - Assist in developing internal tools, ROI frameworks, and proofs-of-concept that scale across the sales org. - Synthesize customer and field insights to support product roadmap and pricing strategy conversations. - Contribute to the company's wildly well-attended intern showcase — presenting your work to Relay's full team at summer's end. ## **Required Qualifications** - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field. - Expected graduation between December 2027 and May 2029. - Minimum GPA of 3.7 - No employer work authorization sponsorship available — candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now or in the future. - Strong quantitative and analytical skills; comfortable building models and working with data. - Excellent written and verbal communication — ability to synthesize complexity into a clear, executive-ready narrative. - Available to work onsite at Relay's Raleigh HQ (near the Lenovo Center) for both the Spring engagement and the full-time Summer program. ## **Preferred Qualifications** - Coursework or project experience in operations research, systems engineering, supply chain, or financial analysis. - Exposure to manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, or hospitality environments through coursework, co-op, or personal experience. - Familiarity with data analysis tools (Excel, Python, SQL) and/or data visualization. - A genuine curiosity about how physical-world businesses operate and where technology creates real impact. ## **What success and impact look like in this role** By the end of the Spring engagement, you've shipped at least one analysis or framework that's been used in a live enterprise deal. By mid-summer, you're running financial models and contributing to business cases with real ownership — not just support. By the final showcase, you've presented work that a senior leader would put in front of a Fortune 500 prospect. Top performers earn a return Summer or Fall 2027 internship offer and are on the radar for full-time consideration upon graduation. ## **What Makes This Internship Different** - **Executive exposure:** Regular touchpoints with Relay's senior leadership team, including Q&A sessions, Breakfast with the CEO, and working sessions. - **Real ownership:** You'll own a project from kickoff to final presentation — not a shadow assignment. - **Cross-functional cohort:** Work alongside interns from across the business, not just your team. - **Structured learning:** Skill-building sessions covering financial modeling, operations strategy, sales craft, and professional development. - **Intern showcase:** Present your work to the full company at the end of the summer. - **Raleigh HQ experience:** Team lunches, volunteer Intern Impact Day, social events, and a front-row seat to how a scaling tech company operates. - **Pathway that matters:** This isn't a résumé builder for its own sake. Strong performers get return offers and full-time pipeline consideration. ## **Why Join Relay?** Our culture hinges on Relayers getting LIT up in an environment that fosters Learning, Impact, and Teamwork, where we CHASE the best work of our lives. role: KIP Spring 2027 - Policy/Research Intern - Competitive Enterprise Institute
description: **[The Koch Internship Program](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/koch-internship-program/) (KIP)** is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the [admissions process](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/application-process/) early! **About Competitive Enterprise Institute:** The [Competitive Enterprise Institute](https://cei.org/) is a nonprofit think tank based in Washington which focuses on critical economic and regulatory policy issues. CEI’s [internship program](https://cei.org/about/internships/) provides interested students and recent graduates the opportunity to learn about and promote the principles of limited government, free enterprise, and individual liberty. A CEI internship gives applicants the opportunity to work alongside some of the most prominent regulatory affairs scholars and policy specialists. CEI offers a number of internships across the various [policy areas](https://cei.org/issue-areas/) we work on, as well as internships in communications and marketing. Generally, CEI’s policy interns are assigned to work with a specific CEI expert for the duration of their internship; and our communications and marketing interns work with the CEI staff of each respective team. CEI’s internship program is an invaluable educational experience. We work with interns to help them grow professionally, hone their skills, and cultivate lasting relationships. Ultimately, our goal is to give interns work that will help them further their careers. Interns are encouraged to be proactive, and exceptional interns are often given the freedom to shape their experience with us and the possibility to explore other opportunities at CEI. Past CEI interns have gone on to work in the executive and legislative branches, federal regulatory agencies, academia, and at prominent research institutions and think tanks. A number of current CEI staff are former CEI interns. You can find out more about CEI [here](https://cei.org/about/) and learn about our history [here](https://cei.org/about/history/). You can see our team of experts here and see some of our work [here](https://cei.org/news-room/) and [here](https://cei.org/publications/). ***Policy/Research Intern:*** Policy/Research Interns are assigned to work with one or more CEI policy experts for the duration of their internship. Interns have the opportunity to research important policy issues which include, but are not limited to; regulatory reform, banking and finance, energy and environment, technology and telecommunications, antitrust, trade, labor, transportation, healthcare, and asset forfeiture. **Qualifications:** Applicants must have a strong interest in policy and politics, capitalism and economics, and libertarian/conservative principles. Applicants must have strong research, writing, and organizational skills. Applicants must possess a professional demeanor and the ability to handle confidential and private information. Applicants should be able to work independently, effectively, and efficiently. A basic understanding of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook is a must. CEI also seeks interns to work on communications, marketing - and from time to time, philanthropy/fundraising, government affairs, events, litigation, and IT. During the interview, we would be more than happy to discuss these other opportunities if they are available and of interest to you! **This role is in person, in Washington, D.C.**

role: Member of Technical Staff Intern - US
description: ## **DRYFT** Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for. Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world. We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads. What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life. We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies. ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next. ​ ## **THE ROLE** As a **Member of Technical Staff Intern**, you'll build the system that decides how some of the largest manufacturers in the world operate. That means combining agent-based reasoning with mathematical optimization and simulation on large-scale industrial data. - **Build agents people trust** – when an agent runs a factory's week, the largest industrial companies in the world have to trust it with their critical processes and understand every decision it makes; you build the routing, orchestration and guardrails behind that - **Ship features end-to-end** – you understand the user need, and you get the freedom to build it across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend and frontend, in production in your first weeks - **Work close to the users** – sit with the planners who use it, see what would make their work 10x faster, and build it You'll own your own features from day one, and what you ship decides what a plant does next week. ​ ## **YOU** - **Full-stack shipper** – you've shipped production code end-to-end, you build scalable backend and infra that handles massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, and you build the interface that makes it usable - **Highly technical** – you've built something technically hard, and you can walk us through every decision behind it - **Product sense** – you spot the feature hiding in a user's complaint, and you've deleted your own favorite one because nobody used it - **You care about getting it right** – you know when it has to be 100% and when to keep it simple, and when it matters, you're still chasing the root cause at 2am - **Sense of urgency** – you'd rather ship it tonight than sleep on an open PR - **Relocation** – you're ready to work onsite in San Francisco (we support visa) ​ ## **TECH STACK** - **FE (TypeScript):** React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite - **BE (Python):** FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster - **AI:** Pydantic AI, Langfuse

coursework, projects, or personal engineering pursuits a plus. - **Technical Skills:** - Basic familiarity with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) from coursework or self-study. - Introductory knowledge of mechanical principles, fasteners, or robotics concepts. - Comfort with Microsoft Word and Excel for documentation and data tracking. - **Communication:** Clear verbal and written skills, eager to learn and engage with a team. - **Problem-Solving:** Curious, detail-oriented mindset with an aptitude for tackling technical challenges. - **Attributes:** Enthusiastic, proactive, and adaptable, with a strong desire to grow in automation - **Teamwork:** Be open to feedback and collaborate effectively with engineers and cross functional departments. - **Initiative:** Show curiosity, take on small tasks proactively, and seek learning opportunities. - **Adaptability:** Adjust quickly when project scopes or priorities shift.

**Controls Engineer Intern** **- Position Description –** **Position Overview:** The Controls Engineering Intern learns and applies foundational automation skills while supporting internal and customer projects under close supervision. The intern works closely with other interns and the Controls team to complete tasks in PLC/HMI/robotics, documentation, and basic commissioning while building good engineering habits in safety, standards, and communication. **Rotational Development Path:** - Rotation 1 – Foundations: Gain familiarity with electrical schematics, PLC coding basics, HMI structure, standards, and documentation. Contribute to Axis internal projects and update documentation for existing customer programs. - Rotation 2 – Expansion: Tackle more advanced internal projects; begin supporting customer projects (electrical design tasks and code edits). Intro to robot programming and simulation. - Rotation 3 – Application: Provide hands-on support to customer projects: schematics updates, programming, commissioning, debug, and runoffs with supervision. **Key Responsibilities:** - Completes structured training/checklists; seeks feedback; applies lessons on subsequent tasks. - Performs small, scoped PLC ladder edits, basic structured-text tweaks, HMI tag routing and simple screens within established architecture and standards. - Reads and updates prints with redlines; maintains I/O lists, tag maps, device tagging, and device databases under review. - Assists I/O checkout, device bring-up, and online debug; follows test procedures; supports FAT/SAT with supervision. - Runs provided simulations; adjusts simple parameters; safely jogs/teaches points with guidance. - Keeps backups, change logs, and manuals current; practices disciplined version control. - Works constructively with Mechanical, Electrical, Build, and PM; communicates status/risks early. - Gathers accurate technical details and relays them to the project lead. - Follows LOTO/site rules; maintains organized benches, panels, and work areas. - Learns and practices our Operating Principles daily; asks for feedback; shows timeliness, accountability, and safe execution on small tasks. **Qualifications:** - **Education:** Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a university program in Electrical/Controls/Mechatronics (or related field). - **Technical Skills:** - PLC/HMI: Basic ladder logic, simple ST edits, tag creation and implementation, simple screens/alarms. - Robotics: Safe jogging, point teaching, basic tool/frame setup. - Electrical Basics: Reads schematics/wire lists; verifies wiring against prints. - Networks & Devices: Basic device/IP setup and commissioning. - Documentation/Tools: Uses templates, checklists, and version control per team process. - **Communication:** Clear, timely communicator with project teams and other interns; asks clarifying questions early; provides crisp status and thorough hand-offs. - **Problem-Solving:** Demonstrates critical thinking and a structured troubleshoot-verify-document approach; knows when to escalate with clear context. - **Teamwork:** Collaborative, coachable, and respectful; supports peers during busy phases and shares what they learn. - **Reliability:** Punctual, meets commitments, follows procedures/standards, and keeps documentation current. - **Travel:** Occasional supervised visits to customer sites or supplier facilities as assigned

Field AI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that address the most complex challenges in robotics, unlocking the full potential of embodied intelligence. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-based architectures, and are charting a new course, with already-globally-deployed solutions delivering real-world results and rapidly improving models through real-field applications. **Hardware Team:** The Hardware Team at Field AI develops perception and compute payloads that power autonomous robotics systems in complex real world environments. Our work spans the full hardware stack designing and integrating sensing systems (LiDAR, camera, TOF, IMU, GPS), embedded compute (CPUs, GPUs, microcontrollers, Linux, ROS), electrical systems (power distribution, communication), and mechanical components (structures, thermal regulation, ingress protection). The team focuses on both development (research, design, prototyping, testing) and operations (production, testing, QA, debugging). We’re a small, fast-moving team, and we care deeply about improving: 1) core capabilities, 2) system reliability, 3) system scalability. As a growing team we are also building operational systems and procedures from the ground up. **Mechanical Systems Role:** As a Mechanical Engineer Intern on the Hardware Team at Field AI, you will contribute to the design and implementation of mechanical systems that house and support sensing and compute platforms in real-world environments. From ruggedized enclosures to thermal management to manufacturability, your work will be critical to ensuring our systems operate reliably in the field. Responsibilities may span the full lifecycle from CAD through production to field support. You will collaborate closely with electrical, compute, and systems engineers to build tightly integrated solutions ready for deployment in challenging field environments. Additionally while your focus will be on mechanical systems you will likely contribute across all hardware domains. **What You Will Get To Do** **Mechanical System Design** - **Structures:** Design and model mechanical structures including external enclosures, internal compute frames, and load-bearing chassis. - **Mounts:** Design and validate robust sensor mounts, payload attachment points, and mechanical interfaces. - **Ingress Protection:** Implement IP-rated solutions with gaskets, seals, membranes, and coatings to meet water/dust ingress standards. - **Thermal Management:** Incorporate thermal mitigation strategies such as fans, heat sinks, conductive paths, and airflow guides. - **Mass & Volume Budgets:** Ensure adherence to payload constraints, including tight volumetric envelopes and weight limitations. **Mechanical System Implementation** - **CAD & Simulation:** Build detailed SolidWorks CAD assemblies. Run FEA and thermal simulations to validate strength, durability, and heat dissipation. - **Material & Component Selection:** Choose materials and components to meet mass, strength, thermal, and manufacturability constraints. Design for Production: Apply DFM, DFA, DFS principles throughout the design lifecycle. - **System Testing:** Conduct mechanical load testing (shock, vibration), thermal validation, ingress tests, and sensor alignment assessments. - **Prototyping:** Rapidly iterate on prototypes for fit checks, thermal evaluations, and integration trials. - **Documentation & Budgets:** Generate mechanical drawings, GD&T annotations, BOMs, and assembly instructions for fabrication and QA. role: Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering - State, Local, Educational (SLED) Corrections and Campus Security
description: Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from [utility inspectors](https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities) to [first responders](https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety), [soldiers in battlefield scenarios](https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr), and [beyond](https://www.skydio.com/solutions). **About the Role:** Skydio is seeking an experienced Solutions Engineering leader to join our team as Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering for Corrections and Campus Security. This is new coverage: Skydio has done corrections work and campus work, but never with a national team dedicated to it, and the knowledge has lived in individual heads rather than in a function. You will build that function from the ground up. This is a remote role. Travel of approximately 30% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events. This role reports to the Director, Solutions Engineering – SLED. **About the Team** The SLED Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's state and local go-to-market motion. We sit between the agency and the product: turning operational problems into program designs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are used, integrated, and flown at scale. The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization. Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Public Safety sUAS programs. **How You’ll Make an Impact:** ### **Lead the team** - Hire, onboard, coach, and retain your team, with clear ownership and coverage across the territories in your segment, and develop people beyond the seat they are in. - Set the bar for technical quality — demos, trial plans, site assessments, and customer-facing documentation that hold up in front of a chief, a sheriff, or a city council. - Own capacity across your segment. Decide where Solutions Engineering time goes, say no when it needs to be said, and make the tradeoffs visible to leadership. ### **Drive technical wins** - Own the technical win across corrections and campus security nationally, two problem sets that share a perimeter security motion but very little else. - Serve as the senior technical escalation point on critical pursuits, deployments, and customer issues. Jump in and work the problem yourself, and be in the field when it matters. - Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline, forecast, and account planning, and on the land-and-expand motion that turns a first dock into a citywide program. ### **Own the corrections and campus problem set** - Build the practice from nothing. There is no playbook, no reference architecture, and no established discovery motion for either problem set, and creating them is the first year of the job. Contraband interdiction, perimeter surveillance, and emergency response are distinct concepts of operation, and part of the job is being candid about where the technology fits and where it does not. - Own site assessment quality as a performance measure. Solutions Engineers are the DRI for verifying a dock location before deployment, and the quality of the resulting installation reflects on the team. - Hold the bar on proofs of concept: structured deployments tied to an active opportunity with measurable operational value, not casual evaluations. - Guide integration and airspace strategy — CAD and dispatch, video and evidence management, streaming platforms, BVLOS approvals, waivers, COAs, and docked operations. - Maintain command of the public sector procurement path, including cooperative contracts, grant funded programs, and public sector buying cycles. ### **Represent the customer inside Skydio** - Be the aggregated voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Turn field observations into prioritized, defensible requirements rather than a list of one-off asks. - Build the enablement content, reference architectures, and reusable technical assets that let the team scale, and maintain first-hand product knowledge through frequent hands-on use. **What Makes You a Good Fit:** - 5+ years of relevant technical experience, including time in a customer-facing technical role (solutions engineering, field engineering, or applications engineering). - 1+ years leading a technical team, formally or as a technical lead with hiring and mentorship responsibility. First-time managers with a demonstrated record of leading and developing people will be considered. - Strong understanding of drone technology, Public Safety sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance, including Drone as First Responder concepts of operation and dock based remote operations. - Working knowledge of Public Safety technologies, including CAD, VMS, and related software platforms, and the ability to lead integration discussions. - A track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing technical people, and of keeping them. - Comfort operating inside a Sales organization, including owning a quota, deal strategy, and the judgment to know when to commit technical resources and when to decline. - Excellent written and verbal communication. You can brief an operator, a program manager, and a senior executive without changing the facts. - Lead by example. Willing to do whatever is needed to get a customer situation resolved. **Nice to Have** - Prior public safety service as a sworn officer, firefighter, or agency UAS program lead. - Experience standing up a Drone as First Responder program from waiver through go-live, and with dock-based, remote, and BVLOS operations at scale. - Familiarity with grant funding pathways and cooperative purchasing vehicles used by state and local agencies. - Working knowledge of Salesforce, Palantir, Databricks, or equivalents. - Track record of building and scaling a technical team through a period of rapid growth. **What Is Required** - Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time. - Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided. - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions. **Compensation:** At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $215,000 - $275,000\*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria. \*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location. #LI-AY1 At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws. For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. The Reliability Engineering team collaborates with our broader Engineering organization to ensure our products meet or exceed mission performance requirements, withstand challenging environmental conditions, and satisfy all customer specifications. As a Reliability Engineering Intern at Anduril, you will gain knowledge of advanced Reliability tools and methodologies to drive excellence into our products. You will support the Systems, Hardware, & Software Engineering teams across the product development lifecycle by participating in Failure Modes & Effects Analysis, predictive analysis, qualification test planning, field performance monitoring, and root cause & corrective action activities. The right person for this role enjoys hands-on work, loves to build processes, and can work efficiently across multi-disciplinary teams. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** - Support review of system block diagrams, interface control documents, and schematics for compliance, redundancy, and accuracy against requirements. - Proactively identify product risks and drive root cause analysis & corrective actions. - Support Failure Modes & Effects Analysis activities and collaborate with other Engineering teams to implement product improvements for Reliability. - Support predictive reliability analysis efforts to calculate failure rates and Mean Time Between Failure metrics, utilizing Anduril requirements, specifications, and MIL-HDBK-217 Plus. - Support the development of Maintainability prediction models using MIL-HDBK-472. - Develop R&D and Qualification Test plans to ensure appropriate requirements coverage. - Work with Quality and Manufacturing Engineering to ensure inspection and acceptance test gates are in place and documented against requirements. - Perform Weibull analysis utilizing data from Qualification campaigns and from fielded assets. - Use data analysis techniques to highlight key problem areas for deployed products, propose corrective actions, and drive to closure. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field. - Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester. - Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program. - Ability to complete an in-person co-op in one of our offices in winter 2027. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Prior internship experience and/or leadership on a collegiate project team or laboratory. - Demonstrated hands-on fabrication skills. - Exposure to test plan development, test data acquisition, data analysis, and failure analysis techniques - Exposure to reliability analysis techniques, such as FMEA/FMECA, predictive modeling, Weibull analysis, and Fault Tree Analysis - Technical writing experience developing standards, specifications, user guides, and policies - Collegiate project team, machine shop, or laboratory experience. - High competence with, and fluid use of, engineering first principles. - Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally - Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite of tools US Hourly Range $40—$48 USD The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. # **About Mercor** Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work.
