role: Traffic / Transportation Engineering Internship - Roadway - Summer 2027
description: We are committed to making a meaningful impact through our work. As a Transportation Engineering Intern, you will join our Transportation Business Line in our Westfield, MA office, where you’ll play a key role in delivering vital infrastructure projects across the Northeast. Working with industry experts, you’ll tackle complex challenges that strengthen community resilience and advance environmental sustainability. At Tighe & Bond, you’ll find an engaging, hybrid work environment, a culture of collaboration, and the resources to support your professional growth and development.

**What We Offer:** Our excellent salary and benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability coverage, education reimbursement, 401(k), performance bonuses, and an employee stock program. Employee Resource Groups and Programs offered include the Young Professionals Group, Women at Wade Trim, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, Professional Development, Leadership Development, Rotation Program, Mentor Program, Sustainability Program, and Wellness Program. **Position Description:** We are looking for an Entry Level Substation Electrical Engineer to join our Industrial Commercial Energy Team to improve infrastructure in our Michigan offices. Candidates should have a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering and zero to three years of experience. Completion of Part I of the Fundamentals of Engineering Exam and knowledge of AutoCAD Civil 3D and Bluebeam Revu is preferred. Strong written and verbal communication/coordination skills are essential. This position will design electrical installation and protective relaying and control (PR&C) components for electrical substation projects, including but not limited to, substation equipment layout, detailed electrical installation design, and PR&C design steel design, in accordance with governing industry codes and standards. This position requires periods of intense concentration. This position is hybrid, with the option to be within a normal office environment, work fully remote, or a combination thereof. This position requires infrequent travel. This position will provide frequent exposure to electrical design standards and codes, including but not limited to, IEEE, NFPA, NEC, and NESC. ### Typical responsibilities include: - Perform high voltage substation design, including electrical installation design and PR&C design with an emphasis on continuous improvement. - Prepare one-line diagrams, electrical installation plans, electrical installation section views, electrical installation details, below grade grounding & conduit plans, and cable schedules in accordance with governing industry code and client standards. - Prepare panel elevations and PR&C schematic, wiring, and interconnection diagrams in accordance with governing industry code and client standards. - Prepare auxiliary power equipment sizing calculations. - Perform complex engineering calculations/studies related to substation projects such as: lightning protection, conduit fill, AC/DC station service loading, surge arrester sizing and voltage drop. - Create SCADA RTU control, status and analog point lists. - Prepare construction drawings with the assistance of a designer/technician competent in the use of industry standard CADD software, and in accordance with client standards. - Prepare construction specifications, project documents, and bill of material lists, in accordance with both client and industry standards. - Attend site visits as required. - Assist in the preparation of proposals. - Assist Project Managers as needed. - Attend client, project and staff meetings including client progress, plan review, pre-construction, etc. - Attend seminars and/or training classes. - Maintain excellent client relations. - Maintain a safe working environment. ### Education: - Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering ### Skills/Experience: - 0 to 3 years of related experience required - Completion of Part I of the Fundamentals of Engineering Exam preferred - Knowledge of AutoCAD Civil 3D, Bluebeam Revu is preferred

**What We Offer:** Our excellent salary and benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability coverage, education reimbursement, 401(k), performance bonuses, and an employee stock program. Employee Resource Groups and Programs offered include the Young Professionals Group, Women at Wade Trim, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, Professional Development, Leadership Development, Rotation Program, Mentor Program, Sustainability Program, and Wellness Program. **Position Description:** We are looking for an Entry Level Civil/Environmental Engineer to join our Industrial Commercial Energy Team to improve infrastructure in our Pittsburgh office. Candidates must possess a bachelor's degree in civil or environmental engineering and have zero to three years of related experience. Knowledge of AutoCAD 3D, Civil 3D and/or Revit is preferred. Excellent writing, organizational and communication skills will be essential. Candidates must be self-motivated and able to work well with others. A flexible hybrid-remote work schedule available after 30 days of employment. ### Typical responsibilities include: - Provide technical planning, design, permitting, and construction support on various water utility projects that may include collection system, pump station, wastewater treatment, reclaimed water, water treatment, water distribution, and various other ancillary civil engineering projects. - Prepare engineering calculations and supporting analysis of alternatives. - Prepare design reports and construction plans using local and state standards. - Prepare construction plans using AutoCAD 3D, Civil 3D and Revit. - Review plans and specifications. - Prepare/assist with permit submittals. - Prepare preliminary project cost estimates and evaluate quantities. - Assist with/review scope, budget, and schedule of new project tasks. - Monitor task budget and progress. - Document design changes and communications. - Conduct on-site inspections as needed. - Prepare project status and other reports. - Assist in the preparation of proposals. - Assist Project Managers. - Attend client, public, project and staff meetings including client progress, plan review, preconstruction, etc. - Maintain excellent client relations. - Maintain a safe working environment. ### Education: - Bachelor's degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering ### Skills/Experience: - 0 to 3 years of related experience required - AutoCAD, Civil 3D and/or Revit experience is preferred - EIT preferred

## **About Base** Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time. ## **About the Role** Base is building a vertically-integrated residential energy company — hardware, software, and field operations all under one roof. As a Supply Chain Tooling & Optimization Intern, you'll work directly with the teams standing up our internally built TMS, WMS, and MRP and scaling deployments across Texas. This is not a shadowing internship: you'll own real problems at the intersection of manufacturing, logistics, and software, building the tools and the intelligent layers on top of them that help us install batteries faster and more reliably. ## **What You’ll Do** - Build internal tools, dashboards, and trackers that increase visibility across the supply chain. - Contribute to our internally built TMS, WMS, and MRP — wiring up data pipelines, integrations, and the models behind them. - Analyze operational data from ERP, supplier portals, and shipping systems to surface bottlenecks, blocked orders, and disruptions. - Prototype inventory and network optimization — multi-site / multi-warehouse stock optimization, warehouse slotting, and staffing/labor planning. - Build first-pass forecasting models for material demand (to feed MRP planning parameters) and for the reliability of supplier commitments — how likely a supplier is to actually hit committed dates and quantities. - Ship these *inside* the tools planners already use, not as notebooks on a shelf — and reach for the simplest method that works. - Partner directly with planners, buyers, and ops managers to scope small MVPs, deploy frequently, and iterate on real feedback. ## **What You’ll Bring** - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Industrial/Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Data Science, or similar. - Comfort writing Python and SQL, and a genuine interest in building tools — not just analyzing data. - Some exposure to at least one of: optimization / operations research or basic ML / anomaly detection (coursework, projects, or prior internships all count). - Familiarity with data analysis and dashboarding; bonus for experience with pipelines, APIs, or ERP systems. - Strong written and verbal communication — able to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Builder mindset — enjoys ambiguity, takes ownership, and is excited to make things *work better*, not just measure them. - Experience in a tech-enabled operations environment is a plus— energy, logistics, or manufacturing. ## **About the Team** Our Supply Chain team tackles the challenge of sourcing battery cells, assembling high-capacity packs, and forging vendor partnerships to produce and deliver the industry's lowest-cost, highest-quality home battery systems at unprecedented scale. By optimizing landed costs through strategic global sourcing, domestic manufacturing ramp-up, and durable supplier relationships, your work directly powers Base Power's mission of advancing human prosperity through energy abundance - delivering reliable whole-home backup and below-market electricity rates to tens of thousands of households. These efforts drive uniquely massive impact by fueling one of America's fastest-growing distributed virtual power plants, already exceeding 200 MWh deployed and aggregating flexible storage to bolster the grid against surging demands from AI, electrification, and extreme weather. Exceptional candidates will seize the chance to build the supply foundation for a company raising billions to manufacture in-house and expand nationally, achieving grid-scale resilience at speeds and costs no traditional player can replicate. *Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.* ## **Our Values** - **First Principles Thinking:** Question assumptions. Principles > rules. - **Operate at Base Pace:** Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing. - **Give & Get Feedback:** Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset. - **Everyone’s an Owner:** Follow through on commitments and own results. - **Strong Opinions, Loosely Held:** Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information. - **Committed to the Mission:** Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in. - **Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit:** Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things. ## **Do the best work of your life at Base.**

You'll be solving hard problems, shaping how users experience our product, and learning from engineers who've been doing this for a while. This co-op is your shot to put your software development skills to work in production. You'll be embedded on one of our engineering teams (see overviews below), take on projects that matter to our customers, and build a technical foundation as you make connections across the business. Our co-ops come from all kinds of coding backgrounds, but they all share one thing: they're excited to build, own, and scale features end-to-end, from scratch. Ownership is expected here, not just encouraged. - Build and ship features that meet a high bar and grow your technical skills while you do it. - Get hands-on debugging real issues, both locally and in production. - Contribute to documentation and support your team during incidents (real-world problems teach you things a tutorial never will). - Work closely with your teammates: ask questions, share ideas, and get better by taking feedback seriously. - Learn to use the right tool for the job, lean into AI, and keep looking for ways to make things better. - Put AI at the center of how you work to move faster. We learn faster together, which is part of why this program happens in person. - You've already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you're excited to find ways to make your work smarter and more efficient. **Co-op logistics** - Our Spring Co-op Program is a paid experience [January 4–June 25] at our Boston, MA headquarters. Team placement can be on a full-stack, back-end, or front-end team within any of the pillars. - Before joining individual teams, all co-ops go through Klaviyo Base Camp, our onboarding experience built to get you up to speed on Klaviyo, our product, and the day-to-day of engineering here. - Our Boston office is genuinely fun. Developed and deployed a new invite management microservice handling multiple roles, statuses, and integrations with audit logs. - Built a real-time data ingestion and aggregation pipeline using kinesis and redshift, with monitoring and validation. - Description When you walk into a building, do you wonder how it actually works? We do too. **Summer Consultants is looking for Mechanical Engineering Interns for Summer 2027.** This is an opportunity for an engineering student who is curious about building systems and wants to see how classroom concepts become real designs in real buildings. At Summer Consultants, we design the mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems that make buildings safe, comfortable, functional, and reliable. Much of our work involves renovating and modernizing existing federal, institutional, higher education, and historic facilities. That means our projects are technical, hands-on, and rarely routine. **As an intern at Summer, you will support real project work alongside experienced engineers. You may assist with surveys, calculations, equipment selection, ductwork and piping layouts, drawings, and other project activities appropriate to your experience and the needs of the team.** Existing buildings do not give you a clean sheet of paper. Our engineers spend real time in the field walking buildings, surveying and documenting existing conditions, tracing systems, observing constraints, and figuring out how a new design can actually work within the building that is already there. The challenge of renovation work is solving real problems: what is already there, what can change, what must remain operational, how equipment and systems fit within existing spaces, and how a design can actually be built. Field surveys are also an important part of how our interns learn. You may help observe and document existing mechanical and plumbing systems, ask questions about what you are seeing, and learn how field conditions affect design decisions. Seeing buildings firsthand helps connect engineering concepts, drawings, and calculations to the systems that are actually installed and operating. Curious about building systems? Let's see what we can do together. **WHAT SUMMER CAN DO FOR YOU** Summer Consultants will help you: - Gain real-world experience in the MEP/FP consulting industry. - Get hands-on experience with HVAC and plumbing design, calculations, equipment selection, layouts, documentation, and existing-building surveys. - Learn how engineers survey buildings, document existing conditions, and turn field observations into practical design decisions. - Build experience with tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, and applicable mechanical design and analysis software. - Work on varied projects. We rarely have "typical" projects because buildings are unique, and so are their systems and constraints. - Learn directly from experienced engineers in the office and in the field. - Collaborate with engineers across disciplines and see how building systems work together. - Work in a small, technically engaged environment where you can ask questions, receive feedback, and build practical engineering experience. **INTERN BENEFITS & SUPPORT** - **Paid sick leave:** One hour of sick leave earned for every 30 hours worked. - **Parking and business travel:** Summer provides parking at no cost and reimburses reasonable approved expenses associated with travel to job sites and other business travel. Requirements **WHAT YOU CAN DO FOR SUMMER** In this role, you may: - Support mechanical and plumbing design work on renovation and existing-building projects. - Participate in field surveys to observe and document existing building conditions and systems. - Assist with HVAC and plumbing calculations, equipment selection, ductwork and piping layouts, and related design activities. - Help translate survey information, calculations, and existing constraints into project drawings and design documentation. - Use tools such as Revit and AutoCAD to support project work. - Coordinate with engineers and designers from other disciplines. - Ask questions, apply feedback, and take on increasing responsibility as your skills develop. - Help solve client problems with curiosity, precision, quality, and follow-through. **WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING WITH YOU** - At least two years completed toward a Bachelor's degree in Architectural Engineering (HVAC focus), Mechanical Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering Technology. - Genuine interest in HVAC, plumbing, building systems, existing-building renovation, and learning how engineering works in practice. - Curiosity about how buildings are constructed, operated, maintained, and modified over time. - Willingness to spend meaningful time in the field surveying existing conditions. - Ability to learn from experienced engineers, ask questions, receive and apply feedback, and contribute as part of a project team. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Strong Microsoft Word and Excel skills. - AutoCAD and Revit experience preferred. - Ability to support day-long field surveys outdoors and indoors, including conditioned and unconditioned spaces, with or without reasonable accommodation. Field work may include walking 10,000 to 20,000 steps in a day, climbing up and down a 6-foot ladder, kneeling, squatting, and bending. - Ability to obtain site access at client locations, including federal facilities, as required by project assignments.

description: Performs sample handling in accordance with state and local EPA regulations. Participates in performing tasks related to sample receipt, storage and disposal as well as shipping samples to outside laboratories. Responsibilities: Follow laboratory standard operating procedures (SOPs) in the handling and disposal of samples. Light laboratory duties Perform sample receiving duties including, but not limited to: sample documentation upon receipt, sample storage and sample disposal. Effectively communicate with Sample Receiving Manager on sample receipt related discrepancies including but not limited to: incorrect bottle type / preservation, additional containers not listed on the chain of custody and reporting when sample receipt temperature is out of spec Packing and shipping samples Preparing client bottle orders Assists laboratory with glassware cleaning for all departments. Assists chemists and other technicians as needed. Perform all responsibilities in a safe and responsible manner in accordance with Eurofins Laboratory safety policy. Maintains a safe and healthy work environment that is in compliance with the requirements of Eurofins Laboratory’s Health & Safety program (and local laws and regulations). Utilizing computer based laboratory information system to electronically track and store sample containers and for shipping purposes Performs all responsibilities in an organized and timely manner in strict accordance with courier arrival times, sample hold times and with the nightly Fedex pickup Basic Minimum Qualifications (BMQ): High school diploma or GED Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) experience helpful The ideal candidate would possess: Computer skills Organizational skills and attention to detail Strong communication (oral and written) Ability to work in a fast-paced production setting Learn quickly Ability to work independently and as part of a team, self-motivation, adaptability, and a positive attitude Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, keep accurate records, follow instructions, and comply with company policies Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds Requirements: Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write and speak in English Position is full-time 2nd shift Monday – Friday 1:30 pm - 10:00 pm. Will train on 1st shift Monday - Friday 9:00 am - 5:30 pm for 1-2 weeks. Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of North Kingstown, RI are encouraged to apply. Pay range: $18-20/hr. Please note - Eurofins Environment Testing (USA) provides a compensation range for informational purposes, the actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill set, base salary of internal peers, business sector, and geographic location. As a Eurofins employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work. we offer excellent benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and dental and vision options. *The benefits package offered will vary based on the employee's full-time or part-time regular status. To learn more about Eurofins, please explore our website . We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique. Sustainability matters to us! At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and Eurofins Scientific 2/2 March 2023 agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. *At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying.* At Klaviyo, our Engineering teams build scalable, high-performance systems that power both our product and the infrastructure behind it. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team whose work reaches thousands of customers worldwide. You won't just be writing code. You'll be solving hard problems, shaping how users experience our product, and learning from engineers who've been doing this for a while. This internship is your shot to put your software development skills to work in production. You'll be embedded on one of our engineering teams (see overviews below), take on projects that matter to our customers, and build a technical foundation as you make connections across the business. Our interns come from all kinds of coding backgrounds, but they all share one thing: they're excited to build, own, and scale features end-to-end, from scratch. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, take on hard technical problems, and ship code that supports Klaviyo's mission. We're an AI-first company, so you'll be expected to use AI tools to support your work, learn faster, and do your best work here. **How you'll make an impact** - Own features that our 180K+ paying customers rely on daily to reach their consumers and grow their business. - Take responsibility for the mission, technical direction, and operation of projects with immediate impact. - Own the full lifecycle of your code: writing it, testing it, shipping it, and making it better over time. Ownership is expected here, not just encouraged. - Build and ship features that meet a high bar and grow your technical skills while you do it. - Get hands-on debugging real issues, both locally and in production. - Contribute to documentation and support your team during incidents (real-world problems teach you things a tutorial never will). - Work closely with your teammates: ask questions, share ideas, and get better by taking feedback seriously. - Learn to use the right tool for the job, lean into AI, and keep looking for ways to make things better. - Put AI at the center of how you work to move faster. Build smarter systems and better workflows from the ground up. **Who you are** - At least one previous software engineering internship or co-op, with hands-on software development experience - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math/Statistics, or a related field - Graduating in December 2027 or May/June 2028 - Experience with some of these technologies and languages: - Python, Django, Typescript, React, Go - MySQL, Cassandra, Clickhouse, Kafka, Redis - Amazon Web Services (EC2, RDS, Aurora, etc.), Terraform - You enjoy working across new technologies and you’re excited to work across the stack from back-end to front-end work - You love digging into performance and scalability issues to find breakthrough solutions: a slow-loading UI, too many clicks in a workflow, a database query timing out, a queue that won't drain. You believe every problem can be solved, and you'd rather run toward it than around it. - You enjoy shipping code early and often, working closely with products to build better software based on feedback from thousands of end users. - You embrace Klaviyo's "always learning" culture. We learn faster together, which is part of why this program happens in person. - You've already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you're excited to find ways to make your work smarter and more efficient. **Internship logistics** - Our Summer Internship Program is an 11-week paid experience [June 1–August 13] at our Boston, MA headquarters. Interns are in office 5 days a week. - Offers will be team agnostic - interns are placed on a team approximately 30 days from the start of the program. Team placement can be on a full-stack, back-end, or front-end team within any of the pillars. - Before joining individual teams, all interns go through Klaviyo Base Camp, our onboarding experience built to get you up to speed on Klaviyo, our product, and the day-to-day of engineering here, plus time to get to know the other interns. description: ## Company Description We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company. We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us. **Job Description** We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Entry-Level Rail Engineer (Engineer-in-Training) to join our growing Rail Construction & Administration Management (CAM) team. This position is designed as a career development opportunity for individuals who are passionate about rail infrastructure, field operations, and hands-on project delivery. As part of our Rail CAM team, you will gain exposure to multiple practice areas, including: - Rail Construction Management - Rail - Public Project Construction Observation - Industry Track Inspection and Owner Representative Services - Rail Geotechnical Engineering and Field Investigations This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy travel, working outdoors, and learning directly from experienced railroad professionals. You'll gain firsthand experience in how railroad and transportation infrastructure projects are planned, constructed, inspected, and maintained while developing the technical, project management, and leadership skills needed for long-term career growth. This is not a traditional office-based engineering position. Our ideal candidate is someone who wants to develop their career through hands-on project experience, frequent field assignments, and exposure to a wide variety of railroad infrastructure projects. Team members work alongside construction managers, track inspectors, owner's representatives, and geotechnical professionals while gaining experience across all Rail CAM service lines. *Travel may be required up to 100% during peak construction seasons and project demands.* ## Qualifications **You are passionate about:** - Working collaboratively with others. - Having ownership in the work you do. - Using your talents to positively affect communities. **You bring to the team:** - Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. - Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification or ability to obtain certification shortly after hire. - Strong communication and teamwork skills. - Demonstrated interest in field-based engineering, construction observation, and railroad operations. - Enthusiasm for frequent travel and extended field assignments, including **up to 100% travel during peak construction periods**. - Ability to work in varying terrain, weather conditions, and active construction environments. - Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite. - Valid driver's license. - Ability to lift and carry equipment weighing up to 30 pounds. #LI-DD1 ## Additional Information Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come. As an Olsson employee, you will: - Receive a competitive 401(k) match - Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths - Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements - Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities - Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance. Olsson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage qualified minority, female, veteran, and disabled candidates to apply and be considered for open positions. **About Us**: Founded 20 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America, Europe and Asia. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser. **Overview:**We are seeking a highly motivated, quick-learning student developer to join our equities desk for the 2027 Summer Internship. You will gain hands-on experience developing components of our cutting-edge, low-latency trading platform. Working alongside experienced developers and traders, you'll contribute to real projects—whether it's optimizing exchange connectivity in C++ or building research pipelines in Python, depending on your primary skills and interests—while learning how technology drives competitive advantage in global financial markets. **Responsibilities:** - Based on your primary language, you will focus on either low-latency system components (C++) or data/backtesting tooling (Python), with opportunities to learn both over time - Assist in the design, development, and maintenance of low-latency trading system components using **C++** - Build tools and scripts in **Python** for data analysis, backtesting, and strategy research - Work alongside senior traders, quantitative researchers, and software developers to understand the full trading technology stack - Optimize and refactor existing code for performance and reliability - Participate in code reviews and team discussions, contributing fresh ideas and learning industry best practices - Further responsibilities may be driven by the individual’s interests and specific skills **Requirements:** - Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field - **Expected graduation date: 2027 or 2028** - Strong proficiency in either C++ or Python (with some exposure to the other language through coursework, personal projects, or prior internships) - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design - Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and basic networking concepts - Detail-oriented with a strong work ethic and eagerness to learn quickly - Genuine interest in algorithmic trading and financial technology - Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment - Prior internship or project experience in low-latency systems, trading, or large-scale data processing is a plus but not required *DV is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. Only search firms with valid, written agreements with DV should submit resumes in response to DV’s posted positions. All resumes submitted by search firms to DV via e-mail, the Internet, personal delivery, facsimile, or any other method without a valid written agreement shall be deemed the sole property of DV, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by DV. DV is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

**About Nominal** Nominal is building the connected test and operations platform powering the world's most advanced hardware systems, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation defense programs. Our platform gives hardware engineering teams a single place to ingest data, analyze performance, automate test execution, and collaborate across every phase of development, so they can move faster without sacrificing safety or precision. We're a fast-moving team that owns problems end-to-end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software. We serve top-tier commercial and defense customers, from autonomy leaders like Anduril and Shield AI to next-generation aerospace teams like Hermeus and REGENT, and performance engineering teams like Pratt Miller Motorsports, alongside mission partners within the U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force on programs where failure isn’t an option. We’re backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, and Lightspeed. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence. **The role** We’re looking for students with solid engineering fundamentals on track to graduate in Summer 2027 or sooner. As a software engineer at Nominal, you’ll have an unparalleled opportunity to work closely with world-class engineers solving high-impact problems. As part of an early-stage company, you’ll help us grow, launch new products, and take on exciting challenges. You’ll have a front-row seat as our customers test and validate complex hardware systems like nuclear reactors, rockets, and supersonic aircraft. ### ### ### 🚀 What you’ll do - Dive deep into cutting-edge data infrastructure, focusing on high-frequency, high-volume multi-modal hardware data - Design and build new features in close collaboration with our customers, often working directly with our users in the field - Quickly take ownership of projects from start to finish, while receiving mentorship from our world-class engineers and domain experts - Take the driver’s seat at an early-stage company, helping Nominal grow, onboarding new customers, and expanding its product offerings, while contributing to our mission of accelerating the testing and validation landscape for complex hardware systems ### ### ### 🎯 Reach out if… - You’re graduating in Spring 2027 or sooner and are interested in a full-time position - You have a personal passion for solving challenging problems and contributing to the future of critical infrastructure - You have exceptional hands-on experience and strong core engineering skills — whether through internships, personal projects, or academic work - Your peers would describe you as ambitious, resourceful, and perseverant ### ### ### ✨ Benefits/Perks - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance - Unlimited PTO and sick leave - Free lunch, snacks, and coffee - Professional Development Stipend - 401k Plan - In-office hardware lab with a $250 project stipend - Annual company retreat *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.* ITAR Requirements *To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Artificial intelligence is changing war - making decisions in combat quicker and more accurate, while enabling information to be shared more rapidly across both America’s and her adversaries’ militaries. Modern Intelligence builds Sovereign, the first defense-purpose foundation AI for unmanned systems, to be the standard battlefield AI on every Western unmanned system. Today, Sovereign allows drones as varied as unmanned vessels on water to backpack attack quadcopters to see, decide, and act even when jammed. We believe the responsibility of reliably and ethically building lethally autonomous AI is immense to our service members, the American people, and civilians everywhere. Modern Intelligence has worked with partners across the Department of War including the Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, Special Operations Command (SOCOM), the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering, and countless unmanned systems hardware companies. We have raised more than $22M in venture capital from Exponential, Oxford Funds, Bedrock, Vine Ventures, Contrary, Air Street, Caffeinated, Champion Hill, Swell, Myelin, and others. ### Details We are looking for a software engineer excited to take technology demonstrated on test ranges and relatively peaceful theaters and see it proven on the battlefield. We have a small software team, but are looking to grow it rapidly. We are seeing significant increase in customer engagement and are looking to expand capacity on an established team. We need engineers willing to travel and support field deployments and integrations. And importantly, we want to take our product to and prove it in Ukraine. Our product, Sovereign, is an Automated Target Recognition and Automated Terminal Guidance solution that works on any platform in any domain - we are currently working to expand its capability to meet any autonomy requirement for any unmanned system. We are looking for engineers passionate about drones, autonomy, supporting our service men and women, and defending democracy and freedom around the world. ### Requirements - Proficiency in a compiled systems language: C++, Rust, or C. Our primary codebase is C++20; we do not expect you to know C++20 on day one, but we do expect you to already think in terms of memory, types, and build artifacts. - Comfortable writing Python. - Comfortable developing on Linux: command line, git, and code review. - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or comparable, or equivalent demonstrated experience. - Willingness to travel and support field deployments and integrations. - Must be a U.S. person (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)). This role works on export-controlled technology. ### Preferred Qualifications - Experience with Bazel, or with CMake and an appetite for learning Bazel. - Applied linear algebra: coordinate frames, covariance, Kalman filters, geodesy. - Experience with Docker and containerized builds. - Experience with video pipelines: GStreamer, ffmpeg, RTSP/RTP/etc. - Experience with an inference runtime such as ONNX Runtime or TensorRT. - Experience with CUDA or GPU programming. - Experience with cross-compilation and embedded Linux, such as Jetson and ARM targets. - Experience with protobuf and/or gRPC. - Experience with TypeScript and React (our operator UI), or with PyTorch (our model training and export) ### Nice to have - Experience with Dart and Flutter. - Experience targeting ML accelerators: Hailo, Qualcomm QNN, XNNPACK, ARM Compute Library. - Experience building for Windows, macOS, or Android. - Experience with MAVLink or other drone software. - Experience with Slurm or other cluster training workflows. - Prior defense industry experience, or an active or previously held clearance.

role: KIP Spring 2027 - Operations Intern - Foundation for Research on Equal Opportunity
description: **[The Koch Internship Program](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/koch-internship-program/) (KIP)** is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the [admissions process](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/application-process/) early! ### **About the Role** [FREOPP](https://freopp.org/) is seeking a highly motivated intern to serve as an Operations Intern in our growing organization. This is a hands-on, high trust role for someone who enjoys learning quickly, solving problems, and bringing structure to a fast paced environment. The Operations Intern will work closely with senior staff and contribute across a wide range of organizational functions, including operations, development, research, scheduling, data management, and special projects. Because FREOPP is a rapidly growing organization, this is not a traditional administrative internship. While the role includes important backend responsibilities that keep the organization running, the Operations Intern will also be trusted with meaningful responsibilities, independent projects, and opportunities to improve how FREOPP operates. The role is intentionally broad and dynamic. The successful candidate should be comfortable handling both routine details and unfamiliar problems, and should approach both with the same level of care. ### **About FREOPP** The Foundation for Research on Equal Opportunity (FREOPP) is a nonprofit think tank that produces policy research and practical implementation strategies designed to expand opportunity for Americans who need it most. FREOPP advances policy ideas that: - address the needs of individuals with wealth or income below the national median; - have the potential to earn bipartisan support; and - increase individual liberty. Through rigorous analysis and practical implementation strategies, FREOPP develops durable policy solutions across healthcare, welfare reform, child welfare, housing, K–12, higher education, and more that expand opportunity and strengthen individual agency. **This is an in person role at our Washington, D.C. office.** ### Responsibilities **Operations & Executive Support** - Support the daily operations of a growing policy organization. - Coordinate meetings, calendars, correspondence, and organizational logistics. - Maintain accurate records and ensure recurring processes are completed reliably and on time. - Assist with event planning, office administration, and other operational needs. **Development & External Engagement** - Support donor and prospect management through CRM maintenance, correspondence, scheduling, and research. - Assist with external communications and donor related projects. - Maintain and improve organizational databases and tracking systems. **Research & Special Projects** - Assist with occasional research and execution of special projects. - Take ownership of development projects from initial research through implementation. **Systems & Process Improvement** - Identify opportunities to improve organizational workflows, databases, and internal systems. - Research and implement tools and processes that help FREOPP operate more effectively. - Develop and maintain trackers, SOPs, and other resources that create consistency and organization. - Document processes to improve future onboarding and continuity. **Wherever Needed** - Jump in wherever needed. The Operations Intern may be asked to tackle anything from financial administration and event planning to research and organizational problem solving. ### Who We’re Looking For We’re looking for someone who: - Is humble and dependable and understands that both small details and larger projects matter. - Takes initiative and has an “I’ll figure it out” attitude. - Learns quickly and is comfortable asking questions. - Is highly organized and detail oriented. - Communicates clearly and professionally. - Can independently manage recurring responsibilities and follow through reliably. - Enjoys creating order out of chaos. - Is willing to take on unfamiliar or unglamorous tasks when necessary. - Is comfortable working in an environment where processes are still evolving. - Brings a positive attitude and works well with a close knit team. - Wants to grow professionally and become a meaningful contributor to the team. **Prior professional or internship experience is not required.** We are more interested in judgment, work ethic, curiosity, communication skills, and willingness to learn than in an extensive resume. ### What You’ll Gain The Operations Intern will have the opportunity to: - Work directly with senior staff at a growing policy organization. - Take on meaningful responsibility rather than simply shadowing or completing routine intern assignments. - Gain exposure to development, operations, policy research, and organizational strategy. - Learn how a small organization operates across multiple functions. - Develop practical skills in systems, project management, research, CRM management, and process improvement. - Contribute ideas and help improve the way FREOPP works.

**JUNIOR FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER** **LOCATION** New York, NY, USA (Hybrid work – required to be in office 2–3 days/week) **JOB DESCRIPTION** At Interplay, we invest, coach, and cofound companies. We're building a next-generation AI operations platform designed to transform how our firm and portfolio companies operate. We're looking for a Junior Forward Deployed Engineer to embed directly with our business lines (Ventures, Accelerator, Studio, and Ascend) and translate real operational needs into working software, fast. Vast is developing next-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Vast offers an advanced manufacturing internship program with hands-on opportunities to design and build space hardware and software. # **Chart Your Journey at Secretariat** From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat. **ABOUT THE FIRM** Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world. From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions. Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives. Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat. **ABOUT OUR ENGINEERING SCIENCES TEAM** As part of our growing Global Engineering Sciences team, you’ll apply what you’re learning in the classroom to real-world engineering challenges across industries such as energy, chemicals, machinery, automotive, consumer products, electronics, medical devices, and the built environment. You may help investigate why products, systems, or structures fail, support testing and analysis, and contribute to projects involving buildings, bridges, industrial facilities, and other structures that shape the world around us. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, scientists, and consultants to learn how engineering is used to solve complex questions related to performance, safety, reliability, and design. This is a great fit for students who are curious, analytical, and excited to build practical technical and consulting skills. Secretariat is a fast-growing international expert services firm with more than 500 professionals in 20+ cities worldwide. For students and early-career professionals, we offer meaningful work from day one, mentorship from leading experts, and the chance to build valuable technical, consulting, and problem-solving skills. **RESPONSIBILITIES** In this role, you’ll build practical engineering, analytical, and consulting skills by supporting real client projects from investigation through reporting. You’ll work with experienced professionals who will help you learn how to break down complex technical questions, analyze information, and communicate your findings clearly. - Support hands-on failure investigations and learn how engineers evaluate what happened, why it happened, and how it can be explained clearly. - Compare real-world conditions with original designs, drawings, specifications, and project documents. - Assist with field inspections, site visits, laboratory testing, and other investigative activities. - Perform engineering calculations, research technical issues, and analyze data to help solve complex problems. - Review, organize, and summarize project documents, technical records, photos, test results, and other relevant information. - Help draft clear, well-supported report sections that explain technical findings in a way clients can understand. - Contribute to visuals, exhibits, and demonstratives that help tell the story of a technical issue or investigation. - Analyze technical reports prepared by others and help develop supporting, concurring, or rebuttal perspectives. - Participate in team and client communications, gaining exposure to consulting work across different industries and time zones. - Build strong working relationships with colleagues, peers, and clients while contributing to a collaborative team environment. - Use curiosity, attention to detail, and strong analytical thinking to help the team meet project milestones and deliver high-quality work. **QUALIFICATIONS** - Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Building Science/Architectural Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree candidates are also encouraged to apply. - Expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2030. - Minimum GPA of 3.0. - Interest in pursuing PE credentials is a plus. - Curious, analytical, and eager to solve complex problems in practical, real-world settings. - Strong communication skills, including listening, writing, presenting, and explaining technical ideas clearly. - Able to learn quickly, think creatively, manage competing priorities, and ask thoughtful questions when guidance is needed. - Comfortable working both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-growing consulting environment. - Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint. - Willingness and ability to travel as needed. - Additional language skills are a plus. - Authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship. ## A rewarding career above all There are a lot of fine consulting firms out there. But when everything is on the line, it takes a unique combination of skill and savvy to succeed under pressure. Our culture and people are driven by passion, pride, and performance. Passion for the clients we serve, the work we deliver, and the communities we live in. Pride in our cohesive team recognized for excellence and trusted to perform in the most challenging situations. And our track record of outstanding performance across all of our disciplines speaks for itself. [Our people](https://secretariat-intl.com/people/) are motivated to be the best in everything they do – from our approach to making the complex simple to the way we mentor our up-and-coming talent to become trusted experts early in their careers. To learn how Secretariat collects, uses, and protects your personal information during the recruitment process, please review our [Privacy Policy](#)

### About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. #### **About the Integration, Quality & Manufacturing Engineering Team** Zipline's Integration, Quality & Manufacturing Engineering (IQME) team keeps the factory floor running smoothly. We're responsible for making sure the right parts and materials are always in the right place at the right time, from receiving and warehouse storage, to staging materials right at the production line, to getting finished goods ready to ship. We work hand-in-hand with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and Material Planning to build and improve the drones, and we're currently standing up brand-new production lines as we scale fast. We're also focused on using better data from production, inventory, and quality data pulled from systems like our ERP, MES, and traceability tools, to help everyone on the floor make smarter, faster decisions. #### **About the Data Analytics Intern Role** As a Data Analytics Intern on the IQME team, you'll dive into the data behind how Zipline actually builds and ships its drones, from inventory and materials to production output and quality. You'll team up with engineers, production leads, quality stakeholders, and leadership to find insights that keep the factory floor running smoothly. Your main focus will be turning data into insights that help people make faster, smarter decisions on the floor. This role is ideal for someone passionate about data, problem-solving, and seeing their analysis translate directly into real operational impact. Along the way, you'll learn from a fast-scaling manufacturing team, giving you a front-row seat to how data drives decisions in a mission-driven environment. **What You'll Do** - Collaborate with production, quality, and supply chain teams to understand what data and insights matter most to the business - Partner with engineers to learn how manufacturing and inventory data is generated and transformed so it's ready for analysis - Write SQL queries and help streamline reporting using Mode, Streamlit or Sigma. - Support data quality efforts by validating datasets and catching issues before they affect reporting - Dig into open-ended questions from the floor and leadership, turning raw data into clear, actionable answers #### **What You'll Bring** - Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field - Comfortable writing SQL queries to calculate metrics and pull insights from data - Some experience with Python for data analysis (scripts, cleaning, or automation) - Experience working with large datasets and turning them into clear findings - Familiarity with a BI/dashboarding tool such as Mode, Sigma, Tableau, Looker, ThoughtSpot, or Power BI - Strong communication skills - able to explain data findings simply and tell a clear story with numbers - Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business questions into technical solutions #### **What Else You Should Know** *This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Spring 2027 interns from January to April.* *Zipline is unable to sponsor work visas for applicants to this position.* Additional benefits may include relocation support, a housing stipend, overtime pay, paid sick time, and other benefits, where applicable and subject to local requirements. *Candidates are limited to **three (3) applications within a 30-day period.*** Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your point of contact at Zipline know if you require any accommodations throughout your interview process. ### **Voluntary Self-Identification** For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file. As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

**About Us** At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space. The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy. ## **About the Summer Internship Program** Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater. Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else. We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer. We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules: **Cohort #1** Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13 **Cohort #2** Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10 All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements. Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package. **About the Team** As a Nuclear Engineering Intern, you will work directly on the design and analysis of Antares reactors. You will contribute to reactor design efforts while helping develop and validate the computational physics capabilities used to inform engineering decisions. Interns will be tasked with small starter projects, and then quickly tasked with a long-duration project that will culminate in a technical deliverable and presentation. You will be integrated and evaluated as if you are a first-year junior engineer, not just an “intern”. The bar for success here is high, and the expectation is that you’re able to smartly use your mentor and the resources around you to execute on your project and identify more issues and opportunities for improvement. **Roles and Responsibilities:** - Drive reactor design work by performing nuclear engineering analyses that inform design decisions. - Develop and validate computational physics capabilities used to analyze and evaluate reactor designs. **Basic Qualifications:** - Enrolled in at least a bachelor’s degree program, and going into your Junior or Senior year of studies. - 6+ months experience of technical engineering skills outside of the university setting classroom (eg: laboratory, research, extracurricular project teams, volunteering, personal projects or prior internship/work experience) **Preferred Skills & Experience:** - GPA of 3.5 or above. - Experience in a University club or organization, leadership role preferred. - Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills (examples: leading a student project team, presenting research at conferences, etc.). - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. - Ability to work cross-departmentally with different groups and teams. - Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements. - Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively. **Location** - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises. **Culture** At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful: - *Think in Systems* - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system - *Obsess over the End User* - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle - *Be Unconstrained by Convention* - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done” - *Go Where the Work I*s - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together - *Operate in the Grey* - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption **Equal Opportunity** Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status. ## **ITAR Requirements** To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Our design team crafts thoughtful experiences across the ecosystem, from consumers ordering their favorite meals to merchants growing their businesses and Dashers delivering with care. ## **About the Role** Design is changing faster than at any point in the last decade, and we’re building the team that defines what comes next. As a New Grad Product Designer, you’ll join and learn from designers shaping this new practice — one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship. You’ll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Dashers, collaborating with product, research, data, and engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people. You’ll join one of our core teams — Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos, Customer Experience & Integrity. Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge. For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles. Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more. We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. # About the Role We are seeking talented engineers to work closely with the broader engineering team for an exciting internship opportunity. description: **About Zoox** Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets. **About Our Part-Time Student Worker Program** Zoox's part-time student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters. ### Role Overview We are seeking a Data Analyst to support the data systems and reporting that power our autonomous fleet operations. You'll transform vehicle telemetry, service logs, and operations data into clear insights that improve decision-making across operations, safety, and engineering teams. This role focuses on analytics, reporting, KPI development, and building accessible datasets and dashboards that help teams understand performance and drive improvements. ### Responsibilities - Analyze vehicle telemetry, service logs, dispatch data, and operational metrics to identify trends and actionable insights - Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports for fleet operations, safety, and engineering stakeholders - Define, track, and report on KPIs related to fleet performance, mission success, readiness, and operational efficiency - Ensure datasets used for analysis are accurate, well-structured, and reliable ### Required Qualifications - Pursuing Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field - Experience with operational, logistics, or fleet-related data is a plus - Strong proficiency in SQL for querying, data manipulation, and analysis - Proficiency in Python for data analysis and reporting preferred - Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or Power BI) - Experience working with large datasets and transforming raw data into actionable insights - Familiarity with Databricks or similar analytics platforms is a plus ### Program Requirements - Construct live operational dashboards to visualize fleet health, downtime metrics, and operator efficiency metrics. - Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline. - Optimize database queries across NoSQL and SQL structures to ensure rapid retrieval of historical fleet data for weekly operational reviews. - Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment. - Aggregate and analyze large sets of vehicle performance data to provide actionable recommendations for improving fleet utilization and reducing idle times. - Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week. - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Able to work on-site at one of our office locations. - Interface directly with L3 hardware and software engineering teams to ensure operational tools accurately reflect the latest autonomous system capabilities and constraints. - Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations. - Gather feedback from on-the-ground fleet operators to continuously iterate and improve the UX/UI of internal tools.
